post.description: Absorbs the body sources Cases into this surviving Case: members re-point, tags and watchers union, and the sources close with a merged-into trace. Gated on canAdminister. 400 when sources is empty; 404 for an unknown or out-of-scope Case; 422 for a non-Case, a self-merge or a source already closed or merged; 409 for an inert object.

post.summary: Split members out of a Case
post.description: Carves the listed member Incidents (body members, title, optional assignee, actor) out of this Case into a new Case. Gated on canAdminister. 400 when title or members is missing; 404 for an unknown or out-of-scope Case or member; 422 for a non-Case, a closed Case or a member it does not contain; 409 for an inert object.

post.summary: Open a Case whose first members are minted from Link Analysis Entities
post.description: LA-CASE-CREATE-IN-PLACE-1. Each {id, dataset} entry is a Link Analysis Entity (node id entity:[<type>:]<normalised key>, D-S4) and is minted as an INCIDENT keyed by entityKey + entityDataset, or REUSED when that identity already exists and is visible to the caller; an {objectId} entry names an existing Incident. The Case CONTAINS every member. Gated on canManageIncidents (403). Missing title or no entities 400; a malformed entity, an entity whose key is a masked pseudonym (masked:<hex>, refused for every caller), an entity of a classified Dataset for a caller without canRevealLinkEntities (value-free, identical whether or not an Incident exists), a non-INCIDENT objectId or more than 100 entities 422; an absent or out-of-scope objectId 404. Everything is checked before the first write, and a failed write rolls back every object the call created.

dataset.description: The Dataset the Entity was projected from

label.description: Title of a minted Incident (the raw spelling)

objectId.description: An existing Incident instead of an Entity

get.description: Returns the registered Case Rules that auto-group Incidents into a Case. No capability gate. 503 when operational objects are not available.

post.description: Creates or replaces a Case Rule (body name, title, filter with at least one criterion, optional threshold, windowMinutes, category, tags), persisted as <name>_caserule.toon under the write root. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 422 for an invalid or unmodelled body or an unsafe name; 403 when the file path escapes the write root; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

delete.description: Removes the Case Rule from the registry and deletes its persisted file. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown Case Rule; 422 for an unsafe name; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.description: Groups the Incidents matching the Case Rule into a Case and returns matched, grouped, caseId and opened. Gated on canAdminister. 404 for an unknown Case Rule.
